notes: ESTIMATE. A stand-in for the ratings car effect (T22), which needs the Jolpica results that stay local (PP-041): the strength of a constructor's car on 0..100 when a career starts in that season. It is an informal reading of the 1954 and 1955 grids, not a measured figure, and is meant to be replaced by the ratings run. A row may give a starting reliability below the strength for a car that was quick but fragile (ESTIMATE too). A constructor that is not listed starts at the tier fallback. It is world setup only: the AI never reads it (PP-050). A fully generated world ignores it and draws its own tiers.
